articles.summary: TetraScience Co-founder & Field CTO Siping "Spin" Wang is moving to Basel to launch our European HQ because the future of Scientific AI requires being "forward-deployed" in life sciences superclusters to bridge the cultural gap and accelerate discovery with a new class of hybrid operators, Sciborgs.
articles.title: Why I’m Moving to Basel: The Future of Scientific AI is Forward-Deployed

articles.summary: Syngenta deploys TetraScience’s Tetra OS and Scientific Data Foundry to industrialize R&D data, eliminate silos, and accelerate scientific discovery in Crop Protection.
articles.title: Syngenta Deploys Tetra OS to Accelerate Scientific Discovery Through Industrial-Scale Data Automation
